export_evidence: ImportKey page for the company (https://importkey.com/countries/india/titagarh-rail-systems-limited) shows 2213 customs records, but every visible row is an IMPORT into India, e.g. "2026-02-20 CANASIA (HK) COMPANY LIMITED → TITAGARH RAIL SYSTEMS LIMITED ... HANGZHOU, CHINA → KOLKATA ACC INCCU4, India, HS 39199090, BOL 7656498". No export row with date/destination/HS/B-L was visible. Company website (https://www.titagarh.in/) only states in its history timeline: "become a significant exporter of freight wagons and components from India" — a claim, not a shipment record.
domestic_evidence: Website timeline lists domestic order awards without shipment/contract documents: "Titagarh has secured the largest-ever order from the Indian Railways, totalling 24,177 wagons" (2022) and "Titagarh & BHEL ... secured a groundbreaking contract for manufacturing and maintenance (for 35 years) of 80 Vande Bharat trainsets" (2023). No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender record or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved (titagarh.in/investors, /annual-reports, /investor-relations all returned HTTP 404; volza, eximpedia, importgenius, trademo blocked with 403/JS challenge).
note: Declared HS 890110 (cruise/similar vessels) does not match the observed trade: actual customs lines are rail rolling-stock components (HS 86079100 EPDM parts, 85364900 relays, 85394900 flasher lights) and the company is a wagon/metro/shipbuilder — HS should be corrected to the factual code (8606/8607 range for freight wagons, 8603 for metro coaches); per project rule this is not a rejection ground. Export status is 'declared_only': the only export statement is the company's own website wording; no dated export bill of lading with destination was found in the accessible sources, so no export shipment is confirmed. Domestic status is 'declared_only': large Indian Railways/Vande Bharat/Gujarat Metro orders are asserted on the company site but no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award record or annual-report revenue split was retrievable in this session. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources reached, not estimated.
